text.aria-label: Subtitle text '16 Primary substations, 292 daily forecast origins, July 2025 to June 2026, injected transfers that start in even months. Rows of the clean set: both draws of injected transfers, without rows the uninjected detector flags. Bins hold the duration of the newest injected transfer active at each origin. 0.5 means no separation.'
text.tspan: 16 Primary substations, 292 daily forecast origins, July 2025 to June 2026, injected
transfers that start in even months. Rows of the clean set: both draws of injected
transfers, without rows the uninjected detector flags. Bins hold the duration of the newest
injected transfer active at each origin. 0.5 means no separation.
